content.short: Honey Chat is a SocialFi platform on Berachain that allows creators to monetize interactions through access passes.
content.description:
Honey Chat is a decentralized SocialFi platform built on the Berachain blockchain, designed to bridge the gap between traditional social media and Web3 ownership. It enables creators to monetize their social interactions through "Access Passes," which are social tokens tied to a bonding curve. Fans purchase these passes to gain access to exclusive content, group chats, and direct messages. This innovative model allows for direct revenue sharing between creators and their communities.

By integrating with X (Twitter) for seamless onboarding, Honey Chat lowers the barrier for Web2 users to enter the Web3 ecosystem. The platform emphasizes data sovereignty, ensuring that users retain ownership of their identity and intellectual property. With a robust system of rewards and decentralized reputation, Honey Chat fosters a transparent and engaging social environment.
